display.purpose: Page H1; one live phrase may take tangerine-display.

title.purpose: H3, FAQ questions, guide list titles, table headers.

answer.purpose: The one-sentence answer under each question.

body.purpose: Paragraphs in soft ink; 1.68 line height and 68ch in guide prose.

button.purpose: Pill buttons; the brand name uses the same face at 800.

shadows.name: screen-lift
shadows.purpose: Screenshot cards and the closing card.

shadows.name: chip-rest
shadows.purpose: Chips and the short-answer box at rest.

shadows.name: button
shadows.purpose: Primary button at rest; hover 0 10px 22px -10px var(--shadow).

shadows.name: shadow-tokens
shadows.purpose: Warm-tinted shadow sources every shadow is built from.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one ease for presses, settles and the theme reveal.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Buttons, chips and the App Store badge on press.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: from translateY(28px) scale(0.985) blur(3px) opacity 0.6, 1.1s ease-out, once
motion.purpose: Screens settling the first time they are seen; only with script and motion allowed.

motion.name: theme-reveal
motion.value: clip-path circle from the switch, 0.8s ease-out (View Transitions)
motion.purpose: Light/dark change; instant under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Inverted ink pill for the one main action per section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:50px; padding:12px 24px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid transparent; background:var(--on, #48443f); color:var(--on-text, #f4f2ee); font:700 1.02rem/1.2 var(--display, "Nunito", ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration:none; box-shadow:0 6px 16px -8px var(--shadow, rgba(38,34,30,0.18)); transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow:0 10px 22px -10px var(--shadow, rgba(38,34,30,0.18)); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #e07b39); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Outlined pill for the secondary action, such as reading a guide.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:50px; padding:12px 24px; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #2a2724); border:1px solid var(--line, rgba(42,39,36,0.13)); font:700 1.02rem/1.2 var(--display, "Nunito", ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration:none; transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { border-color:color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #2a2724) 40%, transparent); } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #e07b39); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Ink link with a tangerine underline.
components.css: .ds-text-link { font-weight:650; color:var(--ink, #2a2724); text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-color:var(--accent, #e07b39); text-underline-offset:5px; text-decoration-thickness:2px; } .ds-text-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness:3px; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #e07b39); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:10px; }

components.name: Question Chip
components.description: Search-style chip that indexes the page questions.
components.html: What does Home show?
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:44px; padding:10px 16px 10px 13px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--raised, #ffffff); color:var(--ink, #2a2724); font:550 0.98rem/1.3 var(--text, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif); text-decoration:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line-soft, rgba(42,39,36,0.07)), 0 1px 2px var(--shadow-near, rgba(38,34,30,0.09)); transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-chip svg { width:17px; height:17px; color:var(--ink-faint, #6b645b); flex:none; } .ds-chip:hover { box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line, rgba(42,39,36,0.13)), 0 6px 14px -8px var(--shadow, rgba(38,34,30,0.18)); } .ds-chip:active { transform:scale(0.97); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #e07b39); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Screen Card
components.description: A real app screenshot on a card-grey Paper card with the app corner; no bezel.
components.css: .ds-screen { margin:0; width:320px; border-radius:22px; overflow:hidden; background:var(--card, #e9e6e0); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--line-soft, rgba(42,39,36,0.07)), 0 2px 6px -2px var(--shadow-near, rgba(38,34,30,0.09)), 0 30px 60px -30px var(--shadow, rgba(38,34,30,0.18)); } .ds-screen-fill { aspect-ratio:4 / 3; background:linear-gradient(135deg, #f6d9a0, #e9e6e0); }

components.name: Appearance Switch
components.description: The app segmented control for light and dark; the selected segment is raised.
components.css: .ds-appearance { display:inline-flex; padding:3px; gap:2px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--card, #e9e6e0); border:1px solid var(--line-soft, rgba(42,39,36,0.07)); } .ds-appearance button { appearance:none; border:0; cursor:pointer; display:grid; place-items:center; width:40px; height:34px; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:var(--ink-faint, #6b645b); transition:background-color .25s ease, color .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease; } .ds-appearance svg { width:18px; height:18px; } .ds-appearance button[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--raised, #ffffff); color:var(--ink, #2a2724); box-shadow:0 1px 2px var(--shadow-near, rgba(38,34,30,0.09)), 0 2px 8px -4px var(--shadow, rgba(38,34,30,0.18)); } .ds-appearance button:hover { color:var(--ink, #2a2724); } .ds-appearance button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #e07b39); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Sticky blurred paper bar: mark and name left, soft-ink links right.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; height:66px; padding:0 24px; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--paper, #f4f2ee) 90%, transparent); backdrop-filter:saturate(1.3) blur(14px); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line, rgba(42,39,36,0.13)); } .ds-brand { font:800 1.4rem/1 var(--display, "Nunito", ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing:-0.02em; color:var(--ink, #2a2724); } .ds-nav nav { display:flex; gap:24px; } .ds-nav a { color:var(--ink-soft, #57514a); font:550 0.98rem/1 var(--text, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif); text-decoration:none; transition:color .18s ease; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current] { color:var(--ink, #2a2724); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent, #e07b39); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:10px; }

Hearth is an iPad app that turns your Home Assistant into a finished dashboard.

narrative.overview:
The site is the Hearth app's Paper look at page scale: a warm off-white ground, ink type, grey cards with the app's soft 22px corner, and real screenshots set directly on that paper with no device bezels. The page reads as a calm sequence of questions and answers. Each section is one answer and one proof, and the screens do the persuading.

Colour stays restrained without going grey. Ink and paper do almost all the work; tangerine appears only where something is live, and two full-bleed bands carry the atmosphere: a lamplight field the colour of a lit lamp and a night band that is always dark, like the app's wall standby. Light and dark follow the device unless the visitor picks one in a segmented switch that copies the app's own control. Display type is rounded (Nunito, after the app's SF Rounded headings); reading type is the system face.

Read surfaces (guides, privacy) share the same frame (nav, footer, buttons, screens) and settle into one calm column with a sticky contents list.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, ink text, grey app cards; no pure white page and no pure black text.
One tangerine, reserved for the live phrase and accent hairlines.
Real screenshots on Paper cards, light and dark in pairs, swapped with the theme.
Two atmospheric bands at most per page: lamplight and night.
Rounded display face, system reading face, pill-shaped controls.

rules.name: The Live Tangerine Rule
rules.body: Tangerine marks what is happening now: one phrase per page heading at most, plus accent hairlines and focus. Buttons, icons and headings are ink, never tangerine.

rules.name: The Two Bands Rule
rules.body: A page carries at most one lamplight field and one night band. Every other section sits on paper or quiet paper.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Every token has a light and a dark value, and every screenshot that has both renders comes in a light/dark pair that follows the page theme.

rules.name: The Rounded Voice Rule
rules.body: Nunito is for headings, buttons, numbers and the brand only; anything read at length is the system face.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase tracked labels above site headings. Small group headings are sentence case in the reading face.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows use the warm ink-tinted shadow tokens and a negative spread so they pool under the object; no grey or black drop shadows with positive spread.

dos: **Do** set real app screenshots on card-grey 22px cards (or the phone radius) with the screen lift shadow, and ship light and dark renders as a pair.
**Do** open every section with the question as a headline and a one-sentence answer in the answer style.
**Do** use the inverted on card for primary buttons and step numbers, and pills for every control.
**Do** keep tangerine to one live phrase per heading, link underlines and focus rings; use `tangerine-text` when it must be read at small size.
**Do** give every new colour a light and a dark value, and check secondary text against its band (lamplight uses `lamplight-ink-soft`).
**Do** use line SVG icons from the shared sprite, inheriting faint ink.
donts: **Don't** draw device bezels or mockup frames around screenshots.
**Don't** colour buttons, icons or whole headings tangerine.
**Don't** add more than one lamplight field or one night band to a page.
**Don't** put uppercase tracked eyebrows or kickers above site headings. The app's own uppercase status lines appear only inside screenshots, as the app draws them.
**Don't** set long reading text in Nunito, or headings in the system face.
**Don't** use hard offset or grey drop shadows; depth comes from tone, the hairline ring and warm diffuse shadow.
**Don't** add candle or fire imagery for warmth; warmth comes from lamplight and paper. The Hearth mark is the identity asset and is used as shipped.
